title: workflow.task.reminder_due.v1
description: Producer: Workflow. An open task reached a reminder point of its SLA (RCU-WFL-003: 50% and 100% of the working-day duration). Notification reminds the users holding assigneeRole, plus any users in assigneeIds. Raised once per task and threshold. Subject: WorkflowTask/<taskId>.

subjectType.description: What the workflow decides on, e.g. Requisition or Offer.

assigneeIds.description: User ids to remind. Empty today: Workflow assigns tasks to a role, not a person.

assigneeRole.description: Role key the task is assigned to (hrta, hrhead, mdceo, ...). Notification resolves it to that role's users.
